title: Khiladi
desc: Raj, Neelam, and Boney prank Sheetal's father with a fake kidnapping, but chaos ensues when Sheetal goes missing, putting them under suspicion and testing their innocence.

title: Hum Aapke Hain Kaun
desc: Prem and Nisha fall in love through family celebrations, but after tragedy, duty and family expectations challenge their chance at happiness.

title: Ten Hours
desc: A missing girl's case leads honest cop Castro onto an overnight bus where a murder unfolds unnoticed. As he probes deeper, a chilling mystery begins to unravel.

title: Baaghi 4
desc: After a failed suicide attempt, a man struggles with reality as hidden truths and obsession blur his world, leaving his family in turmoil and his path tangled in love and mystery.

title: Simmba
desc: Simmba, a corrupt cop, works for smuggler Durva. But when Durva's brothers assault a woman, Simmba changes sides and seeks justice, risking everything to make things right.

title: Raksha Bandhan
desc: The eldest brother of four sisters, a humble chaat seller, struggles to honor his ailing mother's wish while steadfastly protecting their family's values and dignity.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Teen Patti
desc: Mathematician Perci Trachtenberg meets Venkat, a genius whose probability theory pulls him into the dark, tempting world of gambling, where brilliance meets greed, risk, and unexpected consequences.

title: Lav Kush
desc: After Ram returns to Ayodhya, Sita is exiled and raises twins Lav and Kush in the forest. Years later, they journey to Ayodhya to meet Ram and narrate the Ramayan.

title: Vijaypath
desc: Justice Saxena sentences a criminal to death. Seeking revenge, Dilawar Singh kills the judge's family and driver. The driver's son, devastated, vows to fight back and settle the score.

title: Daraar
desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy businessman, falls for Priya Bhatia, a charming real estate agent. But when he proposes, his world shatters-Priya is already married.

title: Sirf Tum
desc: Deepak and Aarti fall in love through letters without ever meeting or knowing each other's address. Longing to see him, Aarti finally travels to Delhi to search for her true love.

title: 2.0 Robot
desc: When mobile phones mysteriously fly from people's hands, Dr Vaseegaran and Nila investigate. To stop Pakshi Rajan's chaos, they must revive Chitti for a decisive battle.

title: AB Tumhare Hawale Watan Saathiyo
desc: Kunal reluctantly joins the army to uphold his family's legacy but soon faces ruthless terrorists threatening Indo-Pak peace, pushing him to rise and protect his nation.

title: Aatma - Feel It Around You
desc: After losing custody of his daughter to Maya, Abhay dies in an accident. Soon, his restless spirit returns, haunting their peaceful lives and unsettling their newfound happiness.
